summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Lots
summary.text: Astrological question chapters from folios 146–149v, covering lots according to Valens, Dorotheus, and Panaretos; fertile days; abundance or privation; absent persons; inquiry purposes; concealment; stellar rays; rulers and successions; hidden things; and diurnal signs. Authorities cited include Paul of Alexandria, Dorotheus, Ptolemy, Valens, Masala, and Maximus and Ammonius.
